The secrets of undeath are recorded within Arkhan's accursed tome.
The dead are given renewed strength, speed and resilience in service to their master.
The Lore of Death is wielded with greater potency and efficiency.
The Winds of Magic gather around the servants of Nagash.
The dark arts of the Vampire Counts are brought under Arkhan's command.
The fallen rise once more to replenish the ranks of the dead.
The legions of the dead return to battle with ever greater resilience.
Even the most grievously wounded dead are restored to the ranks.
Ghouls and Crypt Horrors strike with greater speed and ferocity.
The cursed hunger of the ghouls sustains them upon the battlefield.
Bats and wolves descend upon the enemy with unnatural speed.
The beasts of the night strike from the flanks, tearing into their prey.
The spectral dead are armed with blades capable of cutting through the living.
The restless dead draw strength from the wounds they inflict upon the living.
The ancient warriors of the dead stand resolute, their armour and weapons strengthened.
Grave Guard hold their ground against attacks from every direction.
Monstrous horrors descend upon the battlefield, tearing through the enemy with savage force.
Even grievous wounds cannot halt the monstrous dead as they descend upon their prey.
Nagash's favoured servants advance with unnatural speed, their terrible weapons striking with greater force.
The chosen of Nagash emerge from the shadows, bringing death to those who stand in their path.

The ancient Necrarch Thutmocris emerges from his sepulchral retreat, eager to serve Arkhan’s grand designs.
Drawn by the scent of death and slaughter, the Ghoul King Talongore joins Arkhan’s growing court of monsters.
The Lahmian seductress Khestra the Pale Lotus emerges from the shadows to serve Arkhan, weaving deception, bloodshed, and dark intrigue into his growing empire of death.
